title: An Actionable Framework for Assessing Bias and Fairness in Large Language Model Use Cases

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model outputs using counterfactual prompt substitution with male and female identifiers (e.g., 'man' vs. 'woman') to measure sentiment parity, lexical consistency, and toxicity differences, as well as testing on a gender-specific stereotype dataset (DecodingTrust Stereotype).
